summary: Frontend-only regression for the Melee DMG 'stuck rolling' fix and the new Weapons section. All acceptance criteria PASS. (1) Seeded an old character with meleeDmg='1xD6' via localStorage; after reload the melee-dmg-roll button correctly displays '1d6' (migration via normalizeDice worked) and tapping it completes to verdict 'DAMAGE' with a numeric total (no stuck 'Rolling…'). (2) Setting meleeDmg to 'abc' triggers the invalid-notation fallback: dice-verdict-text = 'INVALID DICE NOTATION', invalid-notation-hint renders with the '1d6/2d8+3' example, and dice-roll-close is visible/functional. (3) '2d8+3' parses and rolls (total observed=18). (4) Weapons section is rendered above 'Once Per Turn' (verified by DOM text index order). (5) add-weapon creates weapon-0 card with all expected testIDs (name/kind/damage-roll/attack/delete). (6) kind chip toggles Melee↔Ranged and shows correct label ('Melee · Melee Attack ≥15' / 'Ranged · Ranged Attack ≥15') using DEX subs. (7) weapon-0-attack rolls d20 vs target (observed d20=14, verdict=FAILURE — effect-total correctly NOT shown on failure, matching the 'effect only on success/crit-success' logic in DiceRollModal). (8) Weapons persist across full page reload (name='Longsword', damageRoll='1d8+2' retained). (9) Regressions clean: character list shows '20 / 20', two rows of 10 HP hearts render, stat-main-STR still triggers a d20 roll modal. No deprecated Expo packages, red screens, or console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: MeleeDmgCell exposes only 'melee-dmg-edit' as a toggle (pencil ↔ check). The test spec says 'Manually setting meleeDmg via melee-dmg-edit' — this works, but the toggle-based UX means the same testID handles enter- and exit-edit. Consider a distinct 'melee-dmg-save' testID for clearer test scripting (not blocking).

DiceRollModal uses optional-chaining `request.effect?.notation` inside the effect-only ticker even though it re-enters the branch only when request.effect is truthy — minor, but the fallback expression evaluates on every tick. Harmless.

getAttackTarget in WeaponCard.tsx falls back to `dex.value` when sub-skill is missing but keeps the label as 'Melee Attack'/'Ranged Attack'. In the current codebase defaultStats always includes these sub-skills so the fallback isn't reached; still, if a user manually renames the sub-skill, the chip label will silently diverge from the actual rolled target. Consider surfacing this.
seed_data_creation: Injected one character into localStorage key 'aob:characters:v1' with id='TESTCHAR-OLD-1', name='OldHero', meleeDmg='1xD6' to exercise the migration path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://campaign-companion-13.preview.emergentagent.com. All data is client-side in AsyncStorage (web localStorage). To reproduce migration tests, seed localStorage['aob:characters:v1'] with a character whose meleeDmg='1xD6' and reload; the migration in loadAllCharacters()->migrateCharacter->normalizeDice will rewrite to '1d6'. Weapon TestIDs use pattern weapon-<idx>-{name|kind|damage-roll|attack|delete}. On success roll (d20>=target OR nat 20) the weapon damage rolls automatically and renders effect-total.
rca_of_issue: Original bug RCA (already fixed by main agent): the strict dice regex could not parse '1xD6' which older seeded characters carried, so rollDice() returned null; the modal's isDone was gated on `effect != null`, leaving it perpetually 'Rolling…'. Fix in place: (a) regex accepts optional [xX*] between count and 'd'; (b) normalizeDice migration on load; (c) invalidNotation state flips isDone true when parse fails. Verified all three paths.
